actions.text: The sniper loads a red cartridge into his futuristic rifle.
The sleeping man wakes up and pulls the newspaper off his face as the searchlight hits him.

camera.text: POV shot through circular scope, tracking the airship
extreme close-up of sniper and rifle
medium shot of the balcony, showing the sleeping man in foreground and sniper in background

analysis.performance_note: The sniper's movements are sharp and deliberate, and the sleeping man's reaction to the searchlight is perfectly timed with the visual effects cue.
analysis.summary: A sniper tracks a futuristic airship through his scope and loads his rifle. As the airship's searchlights illuminate the area, a man sleeping under a newspaper on a balcony wakes up in surprise.
